verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the manuscript-curation deliverable: review 720 questions and identify outdated, irrelevant, or overlapping questions for removal.

value_updates.proposed_removal_editing_method: delete proposed removals in the shared Google Doc using suggesting mode
value_updates.removal_rationale_location: comment attached to each proposed deletion

verdicts.decision_note: The client defines the required Google Doc editing method and rationale artifact for each proposed question removal; separating these from curation action types preserves replay integrity.
The client expands individual-question curation to additions and rewording and requires coverage across all existing chapters or categories and the full 720-question set.
The client explicitly ends the project, removing the remaining question-curation deliverable.
